nodes.title: Hub cylindrical body
nodes.brief: Create hub cylinder. Hub OD = 28 mm (must be < 29.5 mm clear diameter so hub does not intersect bolt holes: clear = PCD 34 - 4.5). Axial hub length default 18 mm. Cylindrical stock. Ledger refs: hub_od_max_constraint, DL1/AC4. Output solid hub ready for flange.

nodes.title: Flange disk on hub
nodes.brief: Add flange disk at one end of hub, coaxial. Flange OD default 48 mm (contains PCD 34 + edge margin). Flange thickness default 5 mm. Do not cut bolt holes yet. Ledger refs: hub_od_max_constraint, DL1/AC3, DL1/AC4.

nodes.title: Sliding-fit bore for d20 h7 shaft
nodes.brief: Cut coaxial through-bore sized H7 for 20 mm shaft: nominal dia 20 H7 (+0.021/0). Target sliding clearance 0.0-0.042 mm; fit_calc mean ~0.027. Through entire hub+flange. Verify concentric. Ledger refs: bore_diameter, fit_bore, DL1/AC1, DL1/AC2.

nodes.title: 4x M4 clearance holes on PCD 34
nodes.brief: Pattern 4 clearance holes for M4 on PCD 34 mm, equally spaced 90 deg, through flange. Clearance hole dia 4.5 mm (standard M4). Holes must not intersect hub (hub OD 28 < 29.5). Ledger refs: hub_od_max_constraint, DL1/AC3, DL1/AC4.

nodes.title: Verify battery + AC pass
nodes.brief: Run verify_battery / assess-model-state on flanged_bushing. Check AC1 sliding fit bore H7 on d20, AC2 clearance band, AC3 4xM4 on PCD 34, AC4 geometry coherent (no hub/hole interference, through features). Report PASS/FAIL per AC.
